change_summary: Update the boundary enforcement text at line 198 to stop claiming the framework never reads journal files. The observe phase found evidence that compile-time code reads journal manifest (run/index.ts:1243) and runstate (run/index.ts:968), making the current text self-contradicting. Replace with accurate text: journal files are runtime artifacts managed by the framework, users must not edit them, and any compile-time reads from journal are tracked exceptions.
